 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correctly spelt word is **'Environment'.**
 
• **'Environment'** refers to the surroundings or conditions in which a person, animal, or plant lives or operates.
 
• Incorrect spellings such as **'Envirmnet'**, **'Enviorment'**, and **'Envirrent'** deviate from the standard spelling.

**Correct sentence:** The word **'Environment'** is correctly spelt and widely used in various contexts, such as ecological, social, and organizational settings.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Definition of Environment:**
 
 
• The physical, social, and cultural conditions that influence the life of an individual or community.
 
• For Example: Protecting the environment is crucial for future generations.
 
 
 
• **Common Usage:**
 
 
• The government is implementing policies to reduce environmental pollution.
 
• The school organized a seminar on environmental conservation.
